frequency_question: How frequently do nominations that reach the active consideration stage successfully secure a recorded Senate confirmation vote within a narrow 15-day window without withdrawal or procedural running out of clock?
membership_rule: Includes all formal cabinet or agency head nominations submitted to the U.S. Senate where floor action is theoretically possible within a 15-day timeframe. Excludes nominations that never reached the floor due to deliberate stalling exceeding the timeframe.

cases.name: Fast-tracked cabinet confirmation in late session
Urgent agency head confirmation under unified control
Tight deadline expiration due to procedural block

coverage_note: 5 named comparable instances of ultra-short deadline confirmations.
known_gaps: Sample is restricted to extremely compressed timelines, which are rare for cabinet posts.
skeleton: Total historical instances of 15-day pre-deadline nomination finalization vs total rushed end-of-term nominations.
validity_reason: Based on Senate procedural rules for nomination cloture and floor scheduling, valid until major rule changes occur.
